name: Pagid Racing
verdict: Pagid Racing is the motorsport brand of TMD Friction, owned by the Munich industrial group Aequita. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Motorsport brake-pad brand of TMD Friction (100% owned, per PAGID's site); TMD was sold by Nisshinbo to Aequita (Munich) in December 2023. No state stake or human-rights finding identified.
